title: Coarse-Grained Modeling of Biomolecular Networks: A Practical Guide
description: Choose bead mappings and effective interactions for biomolecular networks, then plan equilibration and independent validation. Worked diagrams connect atomic groups, reference distributions and the mechanical quantities a coarse-grained model should preserve.

title: 生物分子网络的粗粒化建模：从映射方案到验证方法
description: 围绕生物分子网络选择珠子映射、有效相互作用与平衡策略，并规划独立验证。通过原子分组、参考分布与有效势的示意，说明粗粒化模型需要保留哪些结构信息和力学观测量。

title: Mechanical Testing of Biomaterials: A Reproducible Protocol Guide
description: Plan specimen geometry, hydration, gripping and strain measurement for reproducible biomaterial tests. Follow force-to-stress conversion, diameter-error propagation and reporting choices to obtain mechanical properties with clearly defined test conditions.

title: 生物材料力学测试：试样制备、应变测量与误差
description: 从试样几何、水合状态、装夹与应变测量出发，建立可重复的生物材料力学测试流程。结合力到应力的换算、直径误差传播和报告要点，明确模量、强度与耗能所对应的测试条件。

title: Setting Up a Python Scientific Computing Environment
description: Set up isolated Python environments, install the scientific stack, and connect the right interpreter to JupyterLab and VS Code. Learn how to diagnose package conflicts and reproduce a working setup.

title: Python科学计算环境：安装、配置与版本管理
description: 从独立环境、工具包安装到 JupyterLab 内核与 VS Code 解释器，逐步建立可复用的科研计算环境。结合版本冲突、安装路径与环境导出示例，说明常见故障该从哪里排查。

title: Common Regression Models in Machine Learning
description: Compare linear regression, regularization, kernel methods, tree ensembles, and boosting through their assumptions and fitting behavior. Use residuals, cross-validation, and suitable error metrics to select a model for numerical prediction.

title: Deep Learning: Neural Networks, Backpropagation and Training
description: Follow a neural network from weighted inputs and activations to loss functions, backpropagation, and optimization. Connect these operations to convolutional, recurrent, and attention models, with practical guidance on training and small datasets.

title: 常用的机器学习回归模型：从线性基准到梯度提升
description: 沿着线性回归、正则化、核方法、树集成与梯度提升，理解各类回归模型如何表达输入和数值目标之间的关系。结合残差、交叉验证与误差指标，判断模型复杂度并选择适合数据的方案。

title: 深度学习基础：神经网络、反向传播与模型训练
description: 从神经元的加权求和与激活函数出发，逐步理解前向传播、损失函数、反向传播和梯度更新。再联系卷积、序列与注意力模型，讨论正则化、迁移学习及小样本研究中的选用方法。

title: NetworkX Fundamentals with Python
description: Represent nodes, edges, directions, and weights in NetworkX, then calculate degree, centrality, clustering, and shortest paths. Compare graph models and community methods while keeping the meaning of each network metric explicit.

title: Machine Learning Classification: Models, Metrics and Validation
description: Compare logistic regression, support vector machines, trees, ensembles, nearest neighbors, and naive Bayes. Read class probabilities and confusion matrices, then choose metrics and validation procedures that match the cost of classification errors.

title: Engineered Superstructures: Origami, Auxetics and Lattices
description: Compare folding, rotating-unit auxetics, honeycombs, lattices and multistable structures through their deformation mechanisms. Geometry diagrams and density-scaling curves connect architectural choices to stiffness, lateral response and energy absorption.

title: Hierarchical Superstructures in Biomaterials
description: Explore how silk, collagen, bone, nacre and cellulose organize structural units across scales. Collagen packing and platelet-interface diagrams explain load transfer and crack deflection, with links to characterization and modeling methods.

title: NetworkX 基础：用 Python 理解、构建与分析网络
description: 用 NetworkX 表达节点、连边、方向与权重，再计算度数、中心性、聚类和最短路径。结合邻接矩阵、经典网络模型与社区发现，说明不同指标回答什么问题，以及如何把结构数据转成可分析的图。

title: 常用的机器学习分类模型：从逻辑回归到梯度提升
description: 比较逻辑回归、支持向量机、决策树、集成模型、近邻与朴素贝叶斯的判断方式。结合概率阈值、混淆矩阵和交叉验证，理解分类错误的类型，并按实际问题选择评价指标与模型。

title: 工程超结构力学：折纸、蜂巢、拉胀与点阵
description: 从变形机制比较折纸、旋转单元拉胀结构、蜂巢、点阵与多稳态结构。借助几何示意和密度标度曲线，建立结构选择与刚度、横向响应、吸能之间的联系，并讨论建模与制备方法。

title: 生物材料的层级超结构：从分子到宏观的力学设计
description: 梳理丝素、胶原、骨、珍珠层与纤维素在不同尺度上的结构组织。通过胶原排列与片晶界面示意解释载荷传递和裂纹偏转，并连接显微表征、力学测试与多尺度建模方法。

title: GROMACS MD Tutorial: Structure Prep to Trajectory Analysis
description: Build a lysozyme-in-water simulation from coordinates and topology through minimization, equilibration and production. Track the files exchanged by grompp and mdrun, then distinguish what RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration and hydrogen-bond analysis measure.

title: GROMACS分子动力学模拟实战：从结构准备到轨迹分析
description: 以水溶液中的溶菌酶为例，从坐标和拓扑构建推进到最小化、平衡与生产模拟。说明 grompp、mdrun 的文件关系，并区分 RMSD、RMSF、回转半径和氢键分析各自回答的问题。

title: SciPy曲线拟合：模型、残差与参数不确定性
description: 从线性趋势、应力松弛到压痕模型，演示 SciPy 曲线拟合中的函数定义、初值、单位与参数边界。通过残差、协方差矩阵和置信区间，理解拟合参数的含义，并检查模型与测量数据是否匹配。

title: Matplotlib与Seaborn科研绘图：图形选择与排版
description: 使用 Matplotlib 与 Seaborn 绘制折线、散点、分布、热图和多幅子图，理解图形选择如何影响读者对数据的判断。结合配色、单位、不确定性、版面尺寸与导出设置，完成可直接用于论文排版的图表。

title: 材料研究的Python工具箱：计算、绘图与数据分析
description: 围绕材料研究中的数据对象，连接 NumPy、SciPy、pandas、绘图、原子结构和图像分析工具。通过力曲线处理、分组统计、显微图像分割与机器学习示例，说明各工具在实际分析中的分工与衔接。

title: Pandas实验数据处理实战：从原始数据到统计分析
description: 用 DataFrame 整理实验记录，处理缺失值、列名与异常数据，再按实验条件汇总重复测量。结合样品编号合并、数据透视和结果导出，保留样品与测量之间的对应关系，方便继续绘图和建模。

title: NumPy实验数据处理：数组、索引与广播运算
description: 把实验测量整理为数组，逐步使用切片、布尔筛选、广播运算和统计聚合。通过应变与应力数据、逐列中心化及简单拟合示例，理解形状和索引如何影响计算，并将处理结果保存为后续分析可用的数据。

title: Stress–Strain Analysis: Modulus, Strength and Energy Density
description: Distinguish engineering and true stress, identify curve regions and calculate elastic modulus, strength and energy density in Python. Geometry and analytic hysteresis diagrams clarify reference-area choices and the meaning of cyclic dissipation.

title: Silk Fibroin: From Molecular Structure to Mechanical Function
description: Connect silk fibroin composition and beta-sheet organization to its two-phase mechanical response. Structural diagrams show crystalline connections and extensible amorphous chains, then relate processing choices to orientation and crystallinity.

title: SEM Fiber Image Analysis: Segmentation, Diameter and Orientation
description: Turn fiber micrographs into calibrated measurements with preprocessing, thresholding, mask cleanup and skeleton analysis. Synthetic geometry explains local diameter and orientation extraction, while Python examples support repeatable batch processing.

title: SciPy Curve Fitting: Models, Residuals and Uncertainty
description: Fit linear trends, stress relaxation, and indentation models with SciPy while tracking parameter units and initial guesses. Interpret residuals, covariance matrices, and confidence intervals to turn a fitted curve into an inspectable physical calculation.

title: Scientific Plotting with Matplotlib and Seaborn
description: Build readable line plots, distributions, heatmaps, and multi-panel figures with Matplotlib and Seaborn. Match visual encodings to the data, keep units and uncertainty visible, and export figures at the dimensions needed for a manuscript.

title: Pandas for Materials Data Processing
description: Organize experimental records with DataFrames, clean missing or inconsistent values, and summarize repeated measurements by condition. Merge related tables by sample identity and export results while retaining the labels needed for later analysis.

title: NumPy for Materials Data: Arrays, Indexing and Broadcasting
description: Load experimental measurements into arrays and work with slicing, Boolean masks, broadcasting, and summary statistics. Use these operations to align observations, center columns, fit simple relationships, and save processed numerical results.

title: Multiscale Modeling of Biomaterials: Models and Parameter Transfer
description: Choose molecular, mesoscopic and continuum representations for biomaterial questions. Follow the transfer of conformational statistics and effective stiffness between models, using representative-volume averaging and Python examples to connect scales.

title: Predicting Fiber Mechanics: Features, Regression and Validation
description: Build a small-data regression workflow for fiber mechanics, from specimen features and preprocessing to model comparison. Examine cross-validation, bootstrap variation, and feature importance to connect numerical predictions with material descriptors.

title: Molecular Dynamics Basics: Your First LAMMPS Simulation
description: Read the structure of a LAMMPS input, set up a first molecular dynamics calculation and inspect basic trajectory outputs. Periodic-distance and Lennard-Jones diagrams explain boundary conditions and interactions before force-field and timestep choices.

title: Fiber Network Mechanics: Key Concepts for Biomaterials Research
description: Understand how fiber waviness, orientation, connectivity and crosslinks shape network mechanics. A straightening sketch and the article’s analytic polynomial illustrate strain stiffening, with experimental and computational routes for studying architecture.

title: Feature Engineering for Materials Science
description: Construct useful material descriptors, encode categorical processing conditions, and handle interactions and missing values. Learn how feature selection and training-only preprocessing keep a small-data model interpretable and its evaluation consistent.

title: Practical AFM Force Curve Analysis with Python
description: Convert AFM deflection into force, correct the baseline and identify contact before fitting indentation data. Calibration geometry, analytic Hertz curves and Python functions connect measured channels to adhesion and elastic modulus with explicit units.

title: 应力—应变分析：弹性模量、强度与能量密度
description: 区分工程应力与真应力，识别曲线的不同变形阶段，并用 Python 计算弹性模量、强度和能量密度。通过参考几何与解析滞回环示意，明确面积定义、切线刚度与循环耗能的含义。

title: 丝素蛋白：从分子结构到力学功能
description: 从丝素蛋白的组成与 β-折叠组织理解两相力学响应。结构示意展示结晶连接和可伸展非晶链段的不同作用，再将脱胶、溶解、后处理和牵伸等工艺与取向、结晶度联系起来。

title: SEM纤维图像分析：分割、直径与取向测量
description: 通过预处理、阈值分割、掩膜清理和骨架分析，将纤维显微图像转化为经过标尺校准的测量结果。构造几何解释局部直径和取向提取，Python 示例支持重复执行与批量处理。

title: 分子动力学入门：你的第一个LAMMPS模拟
description: 读懂 LAMMPS 输入脚本的组成，准备首个分子动力学计算并查看基本轨迹输出。通过周期距离和 Lennard-Jones 势图理解边界条件与相互作用，再讨论力场、时间步长和常见运行问题。

title: 纤维网络力学基础：生物材料研究的关键概念
description: 理解纤维弯曲、取向、连接性与交联如何影响网络力学。通过链段拉直示意和正文解析多项式解释应变强化，再连接结构表征、力学测试及网络计算，研究架构与性能的关系。

title: 材料特征工程：描述符构造、编码与特征选择
description: 从材料描述符与制备条件构造特征矩阵，处理分类变量、物理交互项和缺失信息。结合小样本特征选择与训练集内的缩放方法，说明怎样保留变量含义、避免目标泄漏，并让模型评价保持一致。

title: 生物材料多尺度模拟：模型选择与参数传递
description: 根据生物材料研究问题选择分子、介观与连续介质模型。沿构象统计和有效刚度的传递关系，结合代表性体积平均与 Python 示例，理解尺度之间如何交换参数、单位和适用条件。

title: AFM力曲线分析：信号标定与弹性模量拟合
description: 从 AFM 偏转信号转换为力，完成基线校正与接触点识别，再对压入数据进行拟合。标定几何、解析 Hertz 曲线与 Python 函数共同说明测量通道如何转换为黏附力和具有明确单位的弹性模量。

title: Python Tools for Scientific Computing in Materials Research
description: Connect NumPy, SciPy, pandas, plotting libraries, atomistic tools, and image analysis to common materials-research tasks. Follow examples of force-curve processing, grouped statistics, microscopy segmentation, and predictive modeling.

title: 纤维材料力学预测：特征构造、回归与模型验证
description: 从纤维样品的结构与制备特征出发，组织小样本回归的数据准备、预处理、模型比较与评价。结合交叉验证、Bootstrap 波动和特征重要性，理解数值预测如何与材料描述对应，并安排后续验证。

title: 高分子结构基础：连接、链长与尺度
description: 从日常材料认识分子连接、链的尺度与分子量平均值，用薄片弯曲实例比较不同数据表示对预测的影响。

title: 高分子构象统计：采样、分布与独立样本
description: 用构象采样理解分布、误差与独立样本，比较按构象和按对象划分数据对模型评价的影响。

title: 生命中的三类长链：蛋白质、糖链与核酸
description: 认识三类生物大分子的单元、顺序与连接，用学习实验检查分子表示是否保留影响预测的排列信息。

title: 高分子的环境响应：水合、温度与电荷
description: 从水合、热运动和电离理解环境作用，计算不同 pH 下的平均电荷，比较只看组成与同时读取环境的回归预测。

title: 高分子链尺寸：末端距、回转半径与标度关系
description: 计算末端距、回转半径和自由连接链的尺寸规律，检验模型对训练范围之外更长链的预测。

title: 高分子链的熵弹性：拉伸模型与参数反演
description: 从构象计数推导熵弹性，用 DNA 拉伸曲线比较物理拟合与神经网络反演，并考察测量范围对参数识别的影响。

title: 高分子链的舒展与塌缩：排除体积和吸引作用
description: 用短链格点模型枚举构象、计算吸引作用下的尺寸变化，并训练同时读取链长与环境的预测模型。

title: 高分子链动力学：Rouse模型、扩散与松弛
description: 运行 Rouse 链轨迹，理解扩散、松弛和时间相关性，用历史观测预测不同时间间隔后的状态。

title: 蛋白质：从序列、折叠到柔性与功能
description: 以公开蛋白质无序区标注为例，比较组成、局部卷积和 ESM-2 表示，学习序列预测与按相似性分组评价。

title: 糖链：连接方式怎样改变水合、识别与支撑
description: 从糖苷键、分支和水合理解糖链，用真实凝集素阵列数据比较组成特征与保留连接类型的图表示。

title: DNA与RNA：序列怎样组织成结构
description: 从核酸方向、互补配对和发夹结构出发，用动态规划计算受控 RNA 结构分布，再训练注意力网络预测逐位置配对概率。

title: 分子怎样聚到一起：自组装、相分离与凝聚体
description: 区分自组装、相分离与凝聚体，用 Flory–Huggins 模型计算共存边界，并训练分类器学习相图与边界附近的状态。

title: 高分子网络与凝胶：交联、贯通和弹性
description: 理解交联、贯通与凝胶弹性，在受控弹簧网络上分别学习贯通判断和指定加载下的刚度预测。

title: 纤维网络的承载机制：取向、拉伸与弯曲
description: 从胶原层级结构与纤维图像出发，理解取向、拉伸和弯曲，并用受控梁网络训练卷积模型预测排列与加载响应。

title: 从分子到样品：制备、加工与层级结构
description: 沿丝纤维成形过程理解牵伸、水分与结构演变，用公开实验数据比较工艺和结构信息对强度、断裂应变预测的作用。

title: 凝胶的黏弹响应：松弛、循环加载与历史效应
description: 结合凝胶循环实验与受控黏弹模型理解松弛、恢复和加载历史，比较 GRU 与物理约束模型的时序响应预测。

title: 小角度散射数据分析：回转半径、噪声与预测
description: 从真实溶菌酶小角度 X 射线散射记录估计回转半径，再用受控散射数据比较预测模型对噪声、背景和缺失观测的响应。

title: 图神经网络：分子连接的表示与性质预测
description: 把糖链连接编码为图，在真实糖链阵列数据上训练消息传递网络，并检查节点重编号、几何信息和独立数据划分的作用。

title: 主动学习：用高斯过程选择下一次实验
description: 在凝胶溶胀虚拟实验中比较随机、空间覆盖与不确定性选样，用高斯过程和校准区间安排下一轮测量。

title: 生物凝胶设计：物理反求与贝叶斯优化
description: 以溶胀比和剪切模量为共同目标，结合物理反求、代理模型和候选搜索完成凝胶设计的数值实践，并安排新增确认测量。

title: 从氨基酸到蛋白质：顺序怎样变成结构
description: 从豆腐、头发和鸡蛋清的变化出发，认识氨基酸、肽键、序列与折叠。沿着测序和结构研究的科学史，逐步理解螺旋、折叠片、分子间连接，以及蛋白质怎样成为有功能的分子和材料。

title: From Amino Acids to Proteins: How Sequence Becomes Structure
description: Starting with changes in tofu, hair and egg white, explore amino acids, peptide bonds, sequences and folding. Follow the history of sequencing and structural chemistry to understand helices, sheets, molecular connections, and how proteins become functional molecules and materials.

title: 怎样把氨基酸按顺序连接：多肽合成的化学
description: 把氨基酸排成指定顺序，需要同时安排反应位置、反应能力和分离方式。从一条短肽的增长出发，理解保护基、固相树脂与片段连接怎样协同工作，再用可调的数量模型观察微小的单步损失如何积累。

title: Joining Amino Acids in Order: The Chemistry of Peptide Synthesis
description: Building a specified peptide requires control of reaction sites, reactivity, and separation. Follow a growing chain to understand protecting groups, solid supports, and fragment ligation, then explore how small losses in individual cycles accumulate.

title: 从混合物中找到一种蛋白质：分离、鉴定与结构测量
description: 一管澄清溶液中可能藏着许多不同的蛋白质。沿着目标的去向，理解大小、电荷与识别怎样成为分离工具，再把色谱曲线、凝胶条带和质谱峰接回样品的身份、数量与状态。

title: Finding a Protein in a Mixture: Separation and Characterization
description: A clear solution can contain many different proteins. Follow a target through separation by size, charge, and recognition, then connect chromatograms, gel bands, and mass spectra to the identity, amount, and state of the recovered sample.

title: 蛋白质怎样工作：携氧、催化与承力
description: 从一次呼吸、一根头发和一条承力肌腱出发，追踪蛋白质怎样结合小分子、加快反应、组织纤维并产生运动。把结构、环境和数量关系放在一起，看清相似的化学骨架为何能完成不同任务。

title: How Proteins Work: Oxygen Binding, Catalysis and Structure
description: Begin with a breath, a strand of hair, and a load-bearing tendon. Follow how proteins bind molecules, accelerate reactions, organize fibers, and generate motion. Structure, environment, and quantitative behavior explain how related backbone chemistry supports different jobs.

title: 一根丝里的材料科学：分子组装、纺丝与生物矿化
description: 蚕茧、蛛网、透明薄膜和含水凝胶可以由相近的蛋白质构件形成，却承担不同任务。沿着丝的分子顺序、组装、纺丝与湿度响应，理解结构怎样留下加工的痕迹，再把这些认识用于多孔支架、矿物复合物和短肽材料。

title: The Materials Science of Silk: Assembly, Spinning and Mineralization
description: A cocoon, a spider web, a transparent film and a water-rich gel can be built from related protein components yet serve very different purposes. Follow silk from molecular sequence through assembly, spinning and hydration, then use those connections to understand porous scaffolds, mineral composites and short-peptide materials.

title: 怎样改变蛋白质而保留功能：化学修饰与连接
description: 给蛋白质接上荧光标签、把酶固定在材料表面、用颜色数出可反应基团，都需要在复杂的分子上选择合适位置。理解反应性、酸碱度、空间可接近性与标记分布，才能把一次化学变化变成读得懂的结构信息和用得上的功能材料。

title: Modifying Proteins While Retaining Function
description: Attaching a fluorescent label, immobilising an enzyme and counting reactive groups with a colour change all require choosing where to act on a complex molecule. Reactivity, acidity, accessibility and the distribution of labels connect chemical modification to interpretable structural information and useful functional materials.

title: 同样的糖怎样长成不同材料：多糖的连接与组装
description: 米饭、棉布、虾壳和关节里的含水组织，都把糖单元组织成了长链。连接位置、空间方向、分支和电荷，让这些长链承担储能、支撑、保水与润滑等不同任务。从单个糖环开始，逐步理解分子结构如何成为材料性质，以及实验怎样读出这些连接。

title: How Sugars Build Different Materials: Polysaccharides
description: Rice, cotton, shells and water-rich joint tissues all organise sugar units into long chains. Linkage positions, stereochemistry, branching and charge turn those chains into stores of energy, structural fibres and hydrated networks. Starting with a single sugar ring, connect molecular structure with material behaviour and the experiments used to identify its linkages.

title: 把糖连接到蛋白质：糖缀合物的结构与识别
description: 糖链是许多生物分子面对水和其他分子的界面。它接在哪里、朝向哪里、彼此相隔多远，都会改变识别和材料行为。从天然糖基化与人工连接的区别开始，理解怎样读出糖链、选择连接位置，并把分子识别变成可解释的表面功能。

title: Connecting Sugars to Proteins: Glycoconjugates and Recognition
description: Glycans form an interface between many biological molecules, water and their binding partners. Attachment position, orientation and spacing influence recognition and material behaviour. Distinguish natural glycosylation from designed conjugation, learn how glycan structures are read, and connect attachment chemistry with useful surface function.

title: 从核苷酸到遗传信息：DNA与RNA的结构和作用
description: 四种字母怎样成为可以复制的信息，柔软的分子怎样成为工作的结构？从核苷酸的连接方向出发，沿着双螺旋、复制实验、RNA折叠和蛋白质合成逐步展开，再理解测量、化学合成与扩增如何利用这些分子规律。

title: From Nucleotides to Genetic Information: DNA and RNA
description: How can four letters encode copyable information, and how can a flexible chain become a working structure? Begin with nucleotide connectivity and follow duplex formation, replication experiments, RNA folding and protein synthesis before exploring how measurement, chemical synthesis and amplification use the same molecular principles.

title: 长链、软物质与时间：高分子物理的起点
description: 橡皮筋为什么回弹，塑料为什么慢慢变形，富含水的凝胶为什么能保持形状？从原子、分子和长链讲起，认识连接与构象、凝聚态与热运动，再用力学量和可操作的松弛实验把材料结构与观察时间联系起来。

title: Long Chains, Soft Matter and Time: A Starting Point
description: Why does rubber recover, plastic creep, and a water-rich gel hold its shape? Begin with atoms, molecules and long chains, distinguish connectivity from conformation, then connect condensed states, thermal motion and mechanical response through an interactive relaxation experiment.

title: 长链怎样变成材料：高分子统计物理的入口
description: 橡皮筋能回弹，塑料熔体会缓慢流动，蛋白质能改变形状并完成特定功能。这些现象都涉及长链分子的许多可能状态。先从链的连接和可数的构象出发，理解概率、熵、热运动与观察时间怎样把微观结构连接到材料的力学、混合和生命功能。

title: How Long Chains Become Materials: An Introduction to Polymer Statistical Physics
description: Rubber recovers, polymer melts flow slowly, and proteins change shape to perform specific functions. These behaviors involve many possible states of long-chain molecules. Begin with connectivity and countable conformations, then connect probability, entropy, thermal motion and observation time to mechanics, mixing and biological function.

title: 从一个状态到许多可能：相空间、概率与系综
description: 知道一条链或一个粒子在哪里，还不足以预测它接下来怎样运动；只看一次测量，也不一定得到稳定的材料性质。从位置与动量出发，建立状态空间和概率平均，再用能量、热浴和粒子交换说明不同系综。最后比较慢跳转过程中的时间平均与系综概率，理解平衡与观测时间之间的关系。

title: From One State to Many Possibilities: Phase Space, Probability and Ensembles
description: Knowing where a chain or particle is does not fully determine its next motion, and one observation need not give a stable material property. Begin with position and momentum, build state space and probability averages, and distinguish ensembles through energy, thermal contact and particle exchange. A slow-jump model then connects equilibrium probabilities with finite observation times.

title: 一条链能占多大空间：理想链的构象统计
description: 沿链量出的长度、两端之间的距离和整条链的空间尺寸，为什么是不同的量？从随机步子出发，逐步理解回转半径、库恩长度、概率分布和熵弹性，再比较柔性链、半刚性链与环状和支化结构。

title: How Much Space Does a Chain Occupy? Ideal-Chain Statistics
description: Contour length, end-to-end distance and overall molecular size measure different things. Random steps lead to the radius of gyration, Kuhn length, probability distributions and entropic elasticity, followed by semiflexible chains, rings and branches.

title: 链遇到自己和溶剂时：排除体积与溶液行为
description: 同一种长链放进不同液体，为什么会舒展、收缩，甚至让溶液变浑？从一根绳子的空间占据开始，理解分子之间的接触如何改变线团大小，再把这些变化与混合、渗透压和溶液浓度联系起来。

title: A Chain Meets Itself and Its Solvent: Excluded Volume
description: Why does the same long molecule expand in one liquid, contract in another, or make a solution turn cloudy? Starting with the space occupied by a flexible chain, this chapter connects molecular contacts to coil size, mixing, osmotic pressure and concentration.

title: 许多长链聚在一起：共混、微相结构与结晶
description: 两种塑料混合后可能形成均匀材料，也可能分成微小区域；把不同链段接在同一分子上，又能得到规则的层和柱。沿着这些现象，从长链的混合自由能走向微相分离与折叠链晶体，理解分子连接、界面和构象如何共同决定材料内部的组织。

title: Many Chains Together: Blending, Microphases and Crystallization
description: Two polymers can form a uniform material or separate into domains. Connecting unlike blocks within each molecule can instead produce organized layers and cylinders. Follow these phenomena from the free energy of mixing to microphase separation and folded-chain crystals, and see how connectivity, interfaces and conformation organize a material.

title: 材料怎样改变状态：相变、临界现象与标度
description: 冰融化时吸热，某些共混物接近分相温度时变得浑浊，磁体升温后会失去自发磁化。这些变化怎样从许多分子的运动中产生？从相平衡和序参量出发，逐步建立自由能、涨落、关联长度与标度的联系，并用可操作的自由能模型比较连续转变和不连续转变。

title: How Materials Change State: Transitions, Criticality and Scaling
description: Ice absorbs heat as it melts, some blends turn cloudy near demixing, and magnets lose spontaneous magnetization on heating. How do collective changes emerge from molecular motion? Starting with phase equilibrium and order parameters, connect free energy, fluctuations, correlation length and scaling, and compare continuous and discontinuous transitions through an interactive free-energy model.

title: 会排列的长分子：高分子液晶的统计物理
description: 长分子既能流动，又能沿某个方向保持集体排列，这种组合使材料具有方向相关的光学和力学性质。从浑浊液体为何仍有秩序讲起，用取向概率、排除体积和平均场逐步解释液晶形成，再把分子模型连接到柔性链、局部纹理与加工后的材料性能。

title: Long Molecules That Align: Polymer Liquid Crystals
description: Long molecules can flow while retaining collective alignment, combining mobility with direction-dependent optical and mechanical properties. Starting with order inside a fluid, use orientation probability, excluded volume and mean fields to explain liquid-crystal formation, then connect molecular models to flexible chains, local textures and processed materials.

title: 材料边界为何重要：高分子表面与界面
description: 水滴是否铺开、胶体是否团聚、涂层是否牢固，都可能由很薄的边界区域决定。跟随一条长链接近墙面、吸附或被一端固定的过程，理解构象、渗透压和界面自由能如何共同作用，再把这些概念用于聚合物刷、共混界面与膜孔中的传输。

title: Why Boundaries Matter: Polymer Surfaces and Interfaces
description: Whether a drop spreads, colloids aggregate or a coating adheres can depend on a very thin boundary region. Follow a chain as it approaches a wall, adsorbs or becomes tethered at one end. Connect conformation, osmotic pressure and interfacial free energy, then apply the ideas to polymer brushes, blend interfaces and transport through pores.

title: 从分枝到凝胶：分形、逾渗与网络
description: 一锅液体为什么会连成能够承力的整体？一团看似稀疏的导电填料怎样贯穿材料？从放大后仍然参差的形状出发，追踪连接形成、网络承力与吸水膨胀的不同机制，理解凝胶形成和凝胶体积转变。

title: From Branches to Gels: Fractals, Percolation and Networks
description: Why can a liquid become a connected load-bearing material? How does a sparse set of conducting fillers span a specimen? Begin with shapes that remain irregular under magnification, then follow connection, mechanical support and solvent uptake to distinguish gel formation from gel-volume transitions.

title: 蛋白质螺旋怎样形成：协同折叠的统计图景
description: 一段蛋白质螺旋的形成，要同时安排原子接触与主链姿势。为什么开始一段比继续延长更有代价，许多微观排列又怎样变成一条实验曲线？从三个位置的手算例子走向有限长链，理解协同性、平均螺旋含量与折叠时间各自回答什么问题。

title: How Protein Helices Form: A Statistical View of Cooperativity
description: Forming a protein helix balances molecular contacts against conformational choices. Why does initiation differ from propagation, and how do many arrangements become an experimental curve? Move from a three-position counting example to finite chains, and distinguish cooperativity, mean helicity and folding times.

title: 变化为什么有方向：不可逆过程与耗散
description: 热茶会冷却，染料会扩散，流动的聚合物会把机械功转为热。能量守恒并没有禁止这些过程倒着发生，那么时间方向从何而来？从粒子计数和随机运动出发，连接熵、扩散、热流与黏性耗散，理解平衡和持续受驱动的材料。

title: Why Processes Have a Direction: Irreversibility and Dissipation
description: Tea cools, dye spreads, and a flowing polymer converts mechanical work into heat. Energy conservation alone does not prohibit the reverse processes, so where does their direction come from? Connect particle counting and random motion to entropy, diffusion, heat flow and viscous dissipation, distinguishing equilibrium from continuously driven materials.

title: 长链怎样移动和回弹：柔性高分子的动力学
description: 同一块软材料，缓慢拉动时会流动，快速拉动时却明显回弹。沿着加载、等待和释放的过程，理解应力如何消失；再把宏观松弛连接到链段运动、流体耦合和缠结约束，用可调节的振荡实验读懂储能与损耗。

title: How Flexible Chains Move and Relax
description: The same soft material can flow under slow loading and recoil under rapid deformation. Follow loading, waiting and release to understand stress relaxation, then connect it to segment motion, fluid coupling and entanglement. An adjustable oscillatory experiment makes storage and loss directly visible.

title: 流动怎样转动分子：高分子液晶的动力学
description: 拉出一根纤维或铺展一层液晶聚合物时，分子不仅移动，还会改变朝向。它们可能稳定地倾斜，也可能持续翻滚；局部排列又会通过弹性、边界与外场形成整幅纹理。从单根杆的转动出发，理解这些运动如何改变流动、光学与加工后的材料结构。

title: How Flow Reorients Molecules: Liquid-Crystal Dynamics
description: During fibre drawing or coating of a liquid-crystal polymer, molecules change orientation as well as position. They may settle at a steady angle or keep tumbling, while elasticity, boundaries and fields organize their collective texture. Begin with a rotating rod and connect these motions to rheology, optics and the structure retained after processing.

title: 均匀材料怎样长出花纹：失稳、图案与尺度选择
description: 一层均匀聚合物溶液可以变成互相连通的两相网络，平整薄膜可以长出孔洞，连接在同一条链上的两种链段又能排成纳米条纹。沿着微小起伏被放大、不同尺度彼此竞争和结构逐渐固定的过程，理解材料为什么出现图案，以及怎样用加工条件改变它。

title: How Patterns Emerge: Instability and Length-Scale Selection
description: A uniform polymer solution can develop connected domains, a flat film can open holes, and two blocks of one chain can organize into nanoscale stripes. Follow the amplification of small fluctuations, competition between length scales and eventual retention of structure to understand why patterns emerge and how processing changes them.

title: 简单规律为何产生复杂变化：混沌入门
description: 一个严格确定的更新规则，也可能产生长期不重复、对起始状态极其敏感的变化。从一条可以手算的迭代关系出发，观察稳定值、周期翻倍和混沌怎样接续出现，再把这些概念带回流动材料的结构反馈、测量和预测问题。

title: How Simple Rules Produce Complex Motion: An Introduction to Chaos
description: A strictly deterministic rule can produce motion that does not repeat over long times and is highly sensitive to its starting state. Begin with a rule that can be calculated by hand, follow fixed points, period doubling and chaos, then connect these ideas to structural feedback, measurement and prediction in flowing materials.

title: 生命中的折叠与自组织：从能量景观到空间图案
description: 一条链怎样形成结构，一群分子怎样变成液滴，局部反应又怎样长成条纹和波？从折叠实验与物质守恒出发，逐步理解自由能、动力学、扩散和持续供能怎样共同组织生命中的材料。

title: Folding and Self-Organization in Living Systems
description: How does a chain acquire structure, a collection of molecules form a droplet, or a local reaction grow into stripes and waves? Folding experiments and material balances lead into free energy, kinetics, diffusion and the energy supplies that organize living materials.

title: 从湿颗粒到纯净熔体：聚合物干燥与脱挥
description: 一颗外表干爽的塑料粒子，内部仍可能留着水或溶剂。沿着一个小分子离开材料的路线，认识扩散、湿度、热量、薄膜与气泡，并用可调的模型理解为什么厚度、空气条件和熔体黏度会改变脱除速度。

title: From Wet Pellets to a Clean Melt: Drying and Devolatilization
description: A polymer pellet that looks dry may still hold water or solvent inside. Follow a small molecule's route out to understand diffusion, humidity, heat, thin films, and bubbles, then explore how thickness, air conditions, and melt viscosity change the rate of removal.

title: 同一种反应，为什么要用不同的反应器
description: 一锅做完再出料、边进料边搅拌、沿着长管连续前进，看起来只是容器不同，却会改变分子经历的浓度、反应时间和产物去向。从一份物料收支表出发，逐步理解反应速率、三种理想反应器、选择性与设备组合，学会判断什么时候需要更大的容器，什么时候应该换一种操作方式。

title: Why the Same Reaction Needs Different Reactors
description: A batch vessel, a continuously stirred tank and a flowing tube expose molecules to different concentrations and reaction histories. Starting with a material balance, this chapter develops reaction rates, three ideal reactor models, product selectivity and reactor combinations, showing when a larger vessel helps and when a different operating strategy matters more.

title: 同一台设备，为什么物料停留的时间不同
description: 平均加热十分钟，并不表示每一小份物料都加热了十分钟。跟随一次示踪物的进入和离开，认识停留时间的分布、测量与计算，再看流动经历怎样影响反应程度、聚合物链长和乳胶粒子的大小。从一条出口曲线读懂设备内部的差别。

title: Why Material Spends Different Amounts of Time in the Same Reactor
description: An average of ten minutes in a heated vessel does not give every portion of material ten minutes of treatment. Following a tracer from entry to exit reveals how residence times are distributed, measured and calculated, and how these flow histories affect conversion, polymer chain lengths and latex particle sizes.

title: 反应为什么越热越快：聚合过程的热平衡与稳定性
description: 从一杯正在固化的树脂出发，沿着产热、传热与反应物消耗，理解温度为什么恢复、跳变或持续升高。通过科学史、热流图和可调参数的反应器，看清聚合自动加速、颗粒传质与设备放大之间的联系。

title: When Reactions Heat Themselves: Thermal Balance and Stability in Polymerization
description: Start with a cup of curing resin and follow heat generation, transfer and reactant consumption. Historical insights, heat-flow diagrams and adjustable reactor models explain temperature recovery, state changes, polymerization autoacceleration and the consequences of scale-up.

title: 反应器怎样塑造材料：流动、混合与工业放大
description: 同一份配方，为什么换一台设备就可能得到不同的材料？从反应物的旅程出发，认识釜、管、薄膜与螺杆怎样安排流动、传热和分子相遇，再用可操作的尺度比较理解工业放大。

title: How Reactors Shape Materials: Flow, Mixing and Scale-Up
description: Why can the same formulation produce a different material in different equipment? Follow the reactants through vessels, tubes, films and screws, then explore how flow, heat transfer and mechanical action change during scale-up.

title: 单体从哪里来：原子、能量与材料的起点
description: 从塑料瓶、凝胶和尼龙追溯单体的制造，沿着裂解、氧化、循环回用与酶催化，读懂分子怎样被准备好，再用连续算例连接产量、热量和设备尺度。

title: Where Monomers Come From: Atoms, Energy and the Start of a Material
description: Trace bottles, gels and nylon back to their monomers. Follow cracking, oxidation, recycle and enzyme catalysis, then connect product output, heat and equipment size through one continuous worked example.

title: 自由基怎样造出不同材料：从活性链到工业颗粒
description: 薄膜、硬壳与纤维都可以从自由基反应出发。沿着增长、转移、分相与颗粒形成，理解速率和分子量为何不同步，以及工业流程怎样把分子事件变成材料性能。

title: How Radicals Make Different Materials: From Active Chains to Industrial Particles
description: Films, rigid housings and fibres can all begin with radical reactions. Follow propagation, transfer, phase separation and particle formation to understand how rate, chain length and manufacturing history become material properties.

title: 从连接方式到材料性格：聚酯、聚氨酯与聚烯烃的制造
description: 衣服、坐垫和水管为何需要不同的分子连接？从数清反应接口开始，理解缩聚如何增长长链、聚氨酯如何形成弹性体和泡沫，再进入催化剂与颗粒内部，看看反应和扩散怎样共同塑造材料。

title: From Molecular Connections to Material Behaviour: Making Polyesters, Polyurethanes and Polyolefins
description: Why do clothes, cushions and pipes need different molecular connections? Count reactive groups, follow chain growth in polycondensation and the formation of polyurethane elastomers and foams, then enter catalysts and particles to see how reaction and diffusion shape materials.

title: 从一件物品认识高分子材料：组成、结构与性能
description: 保鲜膜、瓶子、橡皮筋和缝衣线都含有长链分子，却承担不同的工作。从这些物品出发，认识分子连接、内部组织、加工历史和性能测量，理解一袋树脂怎样成为能够使用的材料。

title: Understanding Polymer Materials Through Everyday Objects
description: Food wrap, bottles, rubber bands and sewing threads all contain long molecular chains but perform different jobs. Starting with these objects, explore molecular connections, internal organization, processing history and property measurements to understand how a resin becomes a useful material.

title: 同样是聚乙烯，为何有的柔软、有的坚硬
description: 从包装膜、瓶体和热收缩套管出发，追踪聚乙烯从高压自由基聚合到催化共聚的发展。通过链长、支化、结晶与网络，理解同一化学骨架如何形成不同的流动、承载与形状恢复能力。

title: Why Polyethylene Can Be Soft or Stiff
description: Starting with wrapping films, bottles and heat-shrink sleeves, follow polyethylene from high-pressure radical polymerization to catalytic copolymerization. Chain length, branching, crystals and networks explain how one chemical backbone acquires different flow, mechanical and shape-recovery behavior.

title: 把聚乙烯的链分清楚：分布、分级与材料设计
description: 一根管道既要容易制造，也要长期承载。从这个具体问题出发，理解链长与支化为什么需要分布描述，再用色谱、结晶分级和量热温度程序，把看不见的链群转变成可以解释的实验曲线。

title: Reading Polyethylene Chain Distributions for Material Design
description: A pipe must be manufacturable and sustain loading over time. Starting with that problem, learn why chain length and branching need distribution descriptions, and how chromatography, crystallization fractionation and calorimetric programs turn molecular populations into interpretable curves.

title: 一个侧基怎样改变塑料：聚丙烯的结构与用途
description: 从反复弯折的瓶盖、透明容器和承载外壳出发，认识聚丙烯甲基的空间排列。把立体规整性、共聚序列、结晶组织和制品几何连接起来，理解透明、刚挺与耐弯折如何由不同结构安排实现。

title: How a Side Group Changes a Plastic: Polypropylene
description: Start with folding lids, clear containers and load-bearing shells to explore the spatial arrangement of polypropylene’s methyl groups. Connect stereoregularity, comonomer sequence, crystalline morphology and product geometry to understand how different arrangements deliver clarity, stiffness and repeated bending.

title: 把两种聚合物混在一起：形态形成与增韧
description: 柔软颗粒怎样改善较硬塑料的抗冲表现？从配方、分布与分散出发，认识液滴破碎、聚并和界面作用，再通过银纹、剪切屈服与粒间基体，把显微形态连接到实际的能量吸收。

title: Mixing Polymers: Morphology and Toughening
description: How can soft particles improve impact behavior in a harder plastic? Begin with composition, distribution and dispersion, follow droplet breakup, coalescence and interfaces, then connect morphology with energy absorption through crazing, shear yielding and the matrix between particles.

title: 从橡胶微粒到抗冲塑料：聚丙烯合金的制造
description: 从一粒多孔聚合物粉体出发，追踪分阶段聚合、熔融混合与冷却结晶怎样共同制造抗冲聚丙烯。通过组成守恒、分级、量热和动态力学，分清总体乙烯含量、柔软相以及真正承担增韧作用的结构。

title: From Rubber Domains to Impact-Resistant Polypropylene
description: Follow a porous polymer granule through staged polymerization, melt mixing and crystallization to understand impact polypropylene manufacture. Composition balances, fractionation, calorimetry and dynamic mechanics distinguish bulk ethylene content from the soft phase and the structures that produce toughening.

title: 从透明塑料到柔软管材：苯乙烯树脂与聚氯乙烯
description: 透明、耐摔和柔软来自不同层次的结构。沿着PS、HIPS、ABS、SBS与PVC的变化，理解长链侧基、橡胶分散相、物理连接点和增塑剂怎样改变光、裂纹与分子运动，再用配方换算和交互曲线把材料设计落到具体数量。

title: From Clear Plastics to Flexible Tubing: Styrenics and PVC
description: Clarity, impact resistance and flexibility arise at different structural levels. Follow PS, HIPS, ABS, SBS and PVC to see how side groups, rubber particles, physical junctions and plasticizers control light, cracks and molecular movement, then connect these mechanisms to formulation calculations and an interactive curve.

title: 塑料怎样承担结构工作：工程塑料的分子设计
description: 从齿轮与连接器的实际要求出发，理解酰胺、酯、芳香骨架及增强纤维如何控制承载、吸湿和耐热。把分子结构、加工历史、蠕变与零件厚度放在一起，建立能够用于选材和设计的判断方法。

title: How Plastics Carry Structural Loads: Engineering Polymers
description: Start with the demands on gears and connectors, then examine how amides, esters, aromatic backbones and fibers control loading, moisture and heat response. Connect molecular structure and processing with creep and section thickness to make practical material-selection decisions.

title: 长链怎样排成晶体：结晶、形态与材料性能
description: 从一片薄薄的聚乙烯晶体，走到晶格、层片与球晶的不同尺度。把成核代价、链段运动、结晶速度和熔化热联系起来，理解冷却、成核剂、流动与退火怎样改变材料的透明度、尺寸与受力行为。

title: How Long Chains Crystallize: Structure, Growth and Properties
description: Start with a thin polyethylene crystal and connect the scales of lattices, lamellae and spherulites. Nucleation costs, molecular mobility, transformation rates and melting enthalpy explain how cooling, nucleating agents, flow and annealing change clarity, dimensions and deformation.

title: 把软段与硬段接在一起：嵌段共聚物和热塑性弹性体
description: 从鞋底回弹和密封圈的持续支撑出发，理解不同片段怎样在同一条链上合作。沿着微区自组装、结构测量和弹性网络，比较嵌段体系、聚烯烃共混物与动态硫化材料，找出柔软、恢复与热加工之间的结构联系。

title: Connecting Soft and Hard Blocks: Copolymers and Elastomers
description: Begin with shoe-sole recovery and sustained support in a seal. Follow block self-assembly, structural measurements and elastic networks to compare molecular block systems, olefin blends and dynamic vulcanizates, connecting softness and recovery to thermoplastic processing.

title: 两种材料怎样共同受力：聚合物共混与复合
description: 从橡胶颗粒阻止脆裂，到纤维接过树脂传来的载荷，理解不同材料怎样在界面两侧合作。把混合自由能、相形态、增容与载荷传递联系起来，再用理想刚度模型比较配方相同、结构不同的结果。

title: How Materials Work Together: Polymer Blends and Composites
description: From rubber particles that promote energy absorption to fibers receiving load through a matrix, explore cooperation across interfaces. Connect mixing free energy, morphology, compatibilization and load transfer, then compare ideal stiffnesses for the same ingredients arranged differently.

title: 会流动也会回弹：看懂高分子的黏弹性
description: 塑料为什么会慢慢变形，熔体为什么会记得刚经过的口模？从力、形变与速率讲起，用松弛、蠕变和振荡实验追踪长链的时间尺度，再把温度、流动失稳与仪器测量联系到真实加工。

title: Flow and Recovery: Understanding Polymer Viscoelasticity
description: Why does plastic deform slowly, and why does a melt remember the die it has just passed through? Begin with force, deformation and rate, then use relaxation, creep and oscillation to trace molecular timescales and connect temperature, flow instabilities and rheometry to processing.

title: 颗粒怎样变成均匀熔体：混合与螺杆挤出
description: 配方相同，混合方式不同，材料为什么会表现不同？从分布与分散讲起，跟随颗粒走过计量、固体输送、熔融和熔体泵送，再用双螺杆结构、能量与停留时间设计具体的配混路线。

title: From Pellets to a Uniform Melt: Mixing and Extrusion
description: Why can identical ingredients produce different materials? Follow distribution and dispersion through metering, solids conveying, melting and melt pumping, then connect twin-screw design, energy and residence time to practical compounding routes.

title: 熔体怎样成为物品：挤出、注射与成型
description: 水管、薄膜、瓶子和外壳为什么使用不同机器？从流动和定形的共同任务出发，比较挤出与注射的过程，计算厚度、锁模力和冷却时间，再认识吹塑、热成型、发泡与逐层制造怎样留下不同内部结构。

title: How a Melt Becomes an Object: Extrusion, Injection and Forming
description: Why do pipes, films, bottles and housings need different machines? Connect flow with shape fixation, compare extrusion and injection, calculate thickness, clamping and cooling, and follow the structures created by blowing, thermoforming, foaming and layerwise manufacturing.
